snippet.title: Engraved Establishment - Demo Release Date
snippet.description:
Mark it on your calendar: the Engraved Establishment Demo is coming on November 2!
Experience 6 days and nights of employment at your Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza location! Create your pizzeria the way you want to make it! Survive until 6 AM from the animatronics heading to your office!
When you’re done, you can experience building the pizzeria with endless possibilities!

Check out the game page on GameJolt!
https://gamejolt.com/games/engraved-establishment/904004
